list.title: Users
list.subtitle: Search by name or email. Every row opens that user's card.
list.emptyDescription: Try a different query, or clear the search.
list.resultsHint: Showing the first {count, plural, one {# result} other {# results}}. Narrow the search if the person you want isn't in the list.
list.noPhoneNote: The list shows email only — the phone number is visible on the user's card.

detail.title: User card
detail.restrictSuspendedHint: Setting status to Suspended ends every active session this user has.
detail.restrictReasonPlaceholder: Why the status is changing — goes on the audit record
detail.rolesHint: Check the roles this user should hold. The full set is sent at once — the platform works out what to grant and what to revoke.
detail.roleTenantNote: TENANT is the floor everyone stands on — held by every account and not removable here.
detail.roleAdminWarning: ADMIN can perform nearly every staff action — grant it deliberately.
detail.rolesReasonPlaceholder: Why the role set is changing — goes on the audit record

new.title: New account
new.subtitle: No password is set here: the platform emails the address below a link to set one.
new.contactHint: Provide an email or a phone number — at least one of them.
new.rolesHint: TENANT is granted to everyone automatically and isn't listed here.
new.reasonPlaceholder: Why this account is being created — goes on the audit record
new.successBody: An email with a link to set a password was sent to that address. No password is shown or set here.
new.errorGeneric: Couldn't create the account. Check the fields and try again.
